# Alteryx Community

> > The official community hub for Alteryx users featuring support forums, user groups, learning resources, certification prep, and the Community Gallery of shared workflows.

Alteryx Community connects data analytics professionals worldwide through regional user groups, multilingual resources, and collaborative knowledge sharing. Members access training through Alteryx Academy, prepare for certification exams, share custom tools in the Gallery, and participate in events like Inspire conferences.

## Key Topics

- Alteryx Designer
- Alteryx Academy
- MyAlteryx
- Inspire Conference
- Community Gallery
- User Groups
- Certification Resources
- Workflow Automation
- Data Analytics
- Regional Meetups
- Learning Resources
- Community Events
- Asia-Pacific User Groups
- Patrick McGarry
- Alter Everything

## Community Resources & Support

- [Community Gallery](https://community.alteryx.com/t5/%E3%82%AE%E3%83%A3%E3%83%A9%E3%83%AA-EN/ct-p/Gallery-Japanese-EN): User-built tools and workflows gallery for sharing and downloads
- [Customer Support Policy Knowledge Base](https://community.alteryx.com/t5/Customer-Support-Policy-Knowledge-Base/tkb-p/support-policy-kb): Customer support policies and documentation knowledge base
- [General Discussions](https://community.alteryx.com/t5/General-Discussions/bd-p/general-discussions): General discussion forum for non-product-specific topics

## Learning & Certification

- [Certification Resources](https://community.alteryx.com/t5/Certification-Resources/tkb-p/exam-prep): Alteryx certification exam prep resources and study materials
- [Videos](https://community.alteryx.com/t5/Videos/bd-p/live-training): Video tutorials library from beginner to advanced training topics
- [Getting Started (French)](https://community.alteryx.com/t5/Bienvenue-dans-Alteryx-Designer/ct-p/starthere-fr): French getting started guide for Alteryx Designer with resources
- [Getting Started (Spanish)](https://community.alteryx.com/t5/Te-damos-la-bienvenida-a-Alteryx-Designer/ct-p/starthere-es): Spanish getting started guide for Alteryx Designer beginners

## Multilingual Community Hubs

- [Japanese Blog](https://community.alteryx.com/t5/%E3%83%96%E3%83%AD%E3%82%B0/bg-p/blog-ja): Japanese-language analytics blog with insights and ideas
- [Involucrarse (Spanish)](https://community.alteryx.com/t5/Involucrarse/ct-p/participate-sp): Spanish-language community participation and discussion hub
